entries.title: Isaiah 59:1
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content:
1 The calamities of the Jews not owing to want of saving power in God, but to their own enormous sins. 16 Salvation is only of God. 20 The covenant of the Redeemer.
